title: Why Are Fire Trucks So Long?

beats.say: Fire trucks are some of the longest trucks in town. Why so long?
Hi! I'm Bolt, the little tow truck. Let's roll!
A fire truck carries long ladders on top. Some ladders can reach as high as a ten-story building!
It also carries hoses, and lots and lots of water to spray.
Firefighters use it to help keep everyone safe.
Can you climb a pretend ladder? Up, up, up! Be kind and wave hello! See you in Tiny Truck Town!

title: Excavators Can Spin All the Way Around!

beats.say: This digger can turn all the way around without moving its wheels. How?
Hi! I'm Bolt, the little tow truck. Let's roll!
An excavator's cab sits on a turntable, so it can spin all the way around!
Its long arm has a big bucket at the end for digging.
And it rolls on tracks, so it won't get stuck in the mud.
Can you spin around slowly like an excavator? Be kind and wave hello! See you in Tiny Truck Town!

title: Why Are School Buses Yellow?
sources: U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration: school bus safety

beats.say: School buses are almost always yellow. Can you guess why?
Hi! I'm Bolt, the little tow truck. Let's roll!
Yellow is super easy to see, even far away and on cloudy days.
When the bus stops, a little stop sign swings out to tell cars to wait.
Then kids can get on and off the bus safely.
Can you make a stop sign with your hand? Be kind and wave hello! See you in Tiny Truck Town!

title: Why Does the Cement Mixer Keep Spinning?
sources: Portland Cement Association: how concrete is made

beats.say: The cement mixer's big drum spins and spins. Why doesn't it stop?
Hi! I'm Bolt, the little tow truck. Let's roll!
Inside is wet concrete. Spinning keeps it mixed, so it doesn't get hard too soon.
When it gets to the building spot, the concrete slides out of a chute.
Concrete dries hard to make sidewalks and roads.
Can you spin your arms like a mixer drum? Be kind and wave hello! See you in Tiny Truck Town!

title: Some Trains Have More Than 100 Cars!
sources: Association of American Railroads: freight rail facts

beats.say: Some trains are so long, you could count cars for a long, long time. How many?
Hi! I'm Bolt, the little tow truck. Let's roll!
Some freight trains pull more than one hundred cars!
The engine is at the front. It pulls all the cars along the tracks.
Train wheels roll on two strong metal rails. Choo choo!
Can you count train cars with me? One, two, three! Be kind and wave hello! See you in Tiny Truck Town!
